description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal full-time role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. We are looking for a leader who can inspire excellence and ensure the highest standards of patient care.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering a supportive environment for both staff and residents. This is an urgent opening, and we are eager to welcome a passionate professional to our team who is ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Proven experience in a nursing leadership role
Experience within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance standards
